title: Monster Speed V3 Step 4 — User-visible-contract-first proof engine
root_cause: Browser verifiers could independently promote incidental URL/query telemetry or hidden implementation details into blocking acceptance gates, causing false failures after the actual user-visible behavior was already healthy.
patch: Add one reusable user-visible acceptance engine that fails closed on stable visible selectors, visible text, preserved markets, required responsive widths, and horizontal overflow while treating query/URL state as telemetry unless a feature explicitly declares it required. Migrate the frozen CFB Top Picks public verifier to the engine and add a real local Playwright proof across 390/768/1440.
